verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, but every piece of evidence describes New Relic as a cloud-hosted SaaS. Agents, the CLI, and nr1 nerdpack:serve run locally, but they only instrument or extend the hosted platform. None of them self-host the core backend, so they earn no credit. Community posts describe users wanting on-prem or local alternatives, and nothing documents a self-hosted New Relic deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
